verdict.summary: Round 4 finds no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect. Cache saving remains restricted to main and to exactly one deterministically ranked group per cache_crate; the stable group-identity tie-break removes input-order dependence. The focused tests cover one-saver-per-key, widest-feature selection, order independence including an exact ranking tie, workflow wiring, and the real assembler-backed non-vacuity proof. The local targeted suite could not execute because PyYAML is absent in this checkout environment, but the proof deliberately fails closed when that dependency is missing and the documented CI job installs it. Findings remain materially unchanged from round 3, so progress is stagnant.
